_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/imaging/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: Window 320x240. Root is a column with padding 10, gap 8, and children are not stretched, so every child starts at x=10 and they stack from y=10. pic size [60,20] -> 10,10,60,20. fit size [80,20] -> 10, 10+20+8=38, 80,20. bad size [40,40] -> 10, 38+20+8=66, 40,40. auto has NO size: with no src yet it measures as the 64x64 placeholder at 10, 66+40+8=114; after fixture.png (16x16) lands it re-measures to 10,114,16,16 -- which is what the rects below pin.
points: (20,20) is in pic's left half (10..40) -- fixture.png's left half is pure red, and 'stretch' fills the 60x20 box exactly.
(50,20) is in pic's right half (40..60) -- pure blue.

(15,48) is in the fit box (10..90 x, 38..58 y) but LEFT of the contained image: 16x16 contained in 80x20 keeps 1.25x -> 20x20 centred in the box 10..90 -> x 40..60. So this pixel is the root's white background, which is what proves 'fit' did not stretch.
(45,48) is inside fit's contained image, left half -> red.
(55,48) is inside fit's contained image, right half -> blue (the image's midpoint is at x=40).
(30,85) is the middle of the failed box (10,66,40,40) -> white: nothing is painted for an error.
(12,120) and (24,120) are inside auto's 16x16 (10..26 x, 114..130 y): left half red (10..18), right half blue (18..26).
_derivation.not_pinned: the callback arities, the poll counts, the IOError number/sentence, UiNode.loadError and the 64x64 placeholder assertion are asserted inside Main.as and reported through <OUT>.done. They are STATE the program produces, so pinning them here would be copying the program's own output; the geometry above is arithmetic on fixture.png's 16x16 and the root's layout constants.
